notes: Raster data of vegetation canopy height derived from spaceborne interferometric synthetic aperture radar (InSAR) data of TanDEM-X with the support of spaceborne laser data of GEDI. In total, the four acquisitions cover the Harapan landscape and the majority of the Bukit Duabelas landscape of the Jambi province, Sumatra, Indonesia. Four variants of vegetation canopy height exist based on different estimation models. The use of the estimation model depends on focused land use type. In general, the sinc empirical estimation model is recommended to use. Pixel size: 25m. Geographic Coordinate System: EPSG 32748.
